units.source_text: 且说须磨浦上，萧瑟的秋风吹来了。

en.t: Now, over the shore of Suma, a desolate autumn wind began to blow.

units.source_text: 源氏公子的居处虽然离海岸稍远，

en.t: Although Prince Genji's dwelling stood somewhat away from the seashore,

units.source_text: 但行平中纳言所谓“越关来”的“须磨浦风”吹来的波涛声，

en.t: the sound of the waves carried by the Suma shore wind, the wind of which Middle Counselor Yukihira had said it came crossing the barrier,

units.source_text: 夜夜近在耳边，凄凉无比，这便是此地的秋色。

en.t: seemed close beside his ears every night, unbearably lonely; such was the autumn scene of this place.

units.source_text: 源氏公子身边人少，都已入睡，只有公子一人醒着。

en.t: There were few attendants near Prince Genji, and they had all fallen asleep; only the prince himself remained awake.

units.source_text: 他从枕上抬起头来，但闻四面秋风猛厉，那波涛声越来越高，仿佛就在枕边。

en.t: He lifted his head from the pillow and heard the autumn wind raging on every side, while the roar of the waves rose higher and higher, as though it were right beside his pillow.

units.source_text: 眼泪不知不觉地涌出，几乎教枕头浮了起来。

en.t: Tears welled up before he knew it, almost enough to set his pillow afloat.

units.source_text: 他便起身，暂且弹一会琴，自己听了也不胜凄楚之感。

en.t: He rose, played the koto for a while, and even as he listened to it himself, he could not bear its sorrowful feeling.
So he stopped playing and recited a poem:
